description:
List the members of a GraphOS organization with each member's user ID, name, and email.
UpdateProposalReviewers takes these user IDs. Match the person the user named, by email when names are ambiguous, and do not list the other members back to the user.
The list is not paginated, so a large organization returns every member.
This tool needs the GraphOS sign-in (OAuth) or a personal API key in the x-api-key header. A graph key cannot read the members and gets NOT_ALLOWED_BY_USER_ROLE.
Provide the organization ID, which GetMyIdentity returns.
name: GetOrganizationMembers
